description: A photograph depicting young perennial crops, identified as vineyards, in Dordogne, France. The image features multiple rows of small, green plants with developing foliage, cultivated in dark, tilled soil. A clear, unplanted strip of bare soil runs between two prominent rows, receding into the background. The agricultural field extends horizontally across the frame under a bright, slightly hazy sky. In the distant background, a line of mature trees or taller vegetation is visible along the horizon. The scene illustrates agricultural land use for permanent crops. Credit for the photograph is C. Alonso.
